A premier architectural landmark of exceptional quality
As a member of the Vinpearl Hotel & Resort Affiliated by Meliá – a hotel brand operating under the international standards of Meliá Hotels International, Vinpearl Ha Tinh Resort is a striking architectural icon located in the heart of the city. Its elegant design, inspired by the lotus flower – the national symbol of Vietnam, stands out as a true landmark.
Boasting panoramic views of the city and a prime location, the hotel is the ideal choice for both leisure travelers and business professionals, offering easy access to local attractions, shopping centers, and dining districts. The modern accommodations, infinity pool, restaurant, bar, and fitness center ensure a comprehensive and fulfilling stay. With a 700-person capacity conference center, the hotel is a reputable venue for large-scale events and meetings in the North Central region of Vietnam.
Deluxe Twin
The Deluxe Twin Room features a refined design with city views and two comfortable single beds — ideal for friends travelling together or business stays. Fully equipped with modern amenities, it offers a relaxing and convenient retreat in the heart of the city.
Deluxe King
Centrally located with vibrant city views, the Deluxe Room features an elegant design and a full range of modern amenities. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a comfortable stay, whether for a business trip or a relaxing getaway.
Deluxe Corner King
The Deluxe Corner Room features a modern design with a spacious corner layout and panoramic city views. A private bathtub adds a touch of relaxation, making it an ideal choice for a comfortable stay in the heart of Ha Tinh.
Premium Twin
The Premium Twin Room offers a spacious layout with an upscale design and two comfortable single beds — ideal for friends or business travellers. Modern furnishings and city views ensure a convenient and relaxing stay.
Premium King
The Premium King Room features a refined and spacious design with a plush king-sized bed, large windows welcoming natural light, and sweeping city views. Thoughtfully equipped with modern amenities, it offers maximum comfort for both business trips and leisurely stays.
Premium Corner King
Bathed in natural light from two sides, the Premium Corner King Room offers sweeping views of the city below. With its modern design, plush king-sized bed, and a quiet, private atmosphere, it’s the perfect retreat for those seeking comfort with a touch of style.
Executive Suite
The Executive Suite is a statement of refined elegance, featuring a spacious layout with a separate living room and a bedroom overlooking the city. Thoughtfully designed interiors and premium amenities create a truly elevated stay for guests who appreciate sophistication and comfort.
Presidential Suite
The Presidential Suite is the most exclusive choice, blending refined design with a spacious layout featuring a living room, private dining area, and separate bedroom. Panoramic city views and premium amenities ensure a truly elevated stay.
